up: Find the distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5728609. Return the molecule ChEMBL ID (chembl_id) and preferred name (pref_name). Join compound_records with docs on doc_id, filter where docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728609', and join molecule_dictionary on molregno. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728609'
